page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by 96 dedicated physical cores of the Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The system features 372.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.88 GB per core. It is equipped with four NVIDIA T4 GPUs from the Turing family, delivering a combined 64 GB of VRAM. This server does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions, and features a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks reveal a clear contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core CPU performance is weak, scoring in the bottom 25% on stress-ng, and single-threaded gzip compression is poor, falling into the bottom 10%. However, the massive core count enables strong multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression both ranking in the top 25%. Memory bandwidth for cached small blocks is strong at 3924.63 GB/sec, while uncached large-block read and write speeds remain average. Redis SET operations are highly efficient, achieving 64.27 million operations per second.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is the lack of local storage and lower single-threaded performance, which makes it less suitable for sequential, non-parallelized tasks. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the hardware profile is optimized for parallel workloads that can leverage the four NVIDIA T4 GPUs and high core density without needing high-speed local NVMe drives. This server is suited for GPU-accelerated workloads, multi-threaded data processing, parallel decompression, and memory-cached database operations like Redis.
